coordinate_system: mm; x across port, y inward from flange front reference plane, z above motherboard top; top view has flange towards negative y; male pin 1 is at positive x

pcb.finish: ENIG preferred; finish is a manufacturer order choice

connector_sample_assumptions.note: Only flange reference size/centres and contact grid are sourced; rear body, solder cups, thickness and shape are illustrative pending selected solder-cup part

holder.nut_thread_requirement: Prototype defaults use M3 captive nuts and jackposts with M3 male rear stems / 4-40 UNC female cable-facing threads. HARTING 09670009924 is a candidate, not a frozen BOM item. Match actual nut dimensions and mounting stem; no assumption of M3.5.
holder.note: Fit prototype. Material, printer hole compensation, nut pockets, fastener lengths and underside clearances require physical checks. 0.80 mm drill is not a finished clearance hole for 0.64 mm square pins.
holder.anchor_assembly_note: Preload anchor bolts after removing the pin-height loading jig and before lowering PCB/DB23. Raised lugs retain recessed Z2.40 head seats and outward-open head pockets. Secure with verified underside retention after installation.
holder.shield_relief_note: Shallow top recesses clear pre-soldered J3 underside fillets; remaining floor is solid. Route shell leads from the PCB top. Recesses are not tool access after seating.

pin_height_jig.note: Loading only, remove before soldering and before anchor bolts are inserted. Equal tip projection depends on measured pre-cut 10.70 mm pin length and common flat stop. Print offset maps assembly Z-6.20 to bed Z0; place STL at Z-6.20 for loading render. Loose pegs locate through original-position printed anchor holes.
